What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Jakku: Rey's Encampment]]: left, the image of [[Jakku: Rey's Encampment]] (holotable commit 022435b); right, the image of [[Jakku: Rey's Encampment (Errata)]] (holotable commit e8445f0). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkureysencampment.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/jakkureysencampment.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
